facts.business: Arman Financial Services Limited is a non-banking financial company (NBFC) operating through its wholly owned subsidiary Namra Finance Limited, primarily engaged in microfinance lending to rural and semi-urban households in India.
facts.related_party_note: Loans & advances to related parties were 9.27% of total loans & advances in FY 2025-26 (0.00% in FY 2024-25). Investments in related parties were 83.05% of total investments in FY 2025-26 (100% in FY 2024-25). Purchases and sales with related parties were nil in both years.
